name: Kanzaki Aoi
source:
Akito's childhood friend and a member of the school's tennis club. A beautiful girl who treats everyone with kindness and is popular with both men and women as a result. Chosen to become the year's Miss Mikage; the school's idol.
She has been targeted by a certain organization to be the subject of a cruel game.
An angel thrust into a world of depravity...
